__NOTOC__
[[Real Virtuality]] is the engine behind most of [[{{Name|bi}}]] games (also previously referred to as "{{Link|#Poseidon}}") until the advent of [[Enfusion]].
It is responsible for handling the graphics, physics, scripting and the user interface.

The different versions of the engine are as follows:

=== Real Virtuality 1 ===

* {{GameCategory|ofp|link= y}}: 1.00 - 1.46
* [[{{ofpr}}]]: 1.75-1.99
* Virtual Battlespace 1: 1.75-2.12.14

=== Real Virtuality 2 ===

* {{GameCategory|ofpe|link= y}}: 2.85
* {{GameCategory|arma1|link= y}}: 5089 - 5151 - 5163 (See also [[ArmA: Armed Assault: Version History#Build numbers|build numbers]])
* Virtual Battlespace 2: 1.19.5630
* Virtual Battlespace 2: VTK

=== Real Virtuality 3 ===

* {{GameCategory|arma2|link= y}}: 57270 (v1.00) - 74450 (v1.08) (See also [[Arma 2: Version History#Build_Numbers|build numbers]])
* {{GameCategory|arma2oa|link= y}} 70996 (v1.50) - 76134 (v1.56) (See also [[Arma 2: Operation Arrowhead: Version History#Build Numbers|build numbers]])
* {{GameCategory|tkoh|link= y}}

=== Real Virtuality 4 ===

* {{GameCategory|arma3|link= y}}

=== Poseidon ===

"Poseidon" is the internally used name of the [[Real Virtuality]] engine, used to drive all {{Name|bi}} games from {{ofp}} to {{arma3}} (with the exception of {{Name|carriercommand}} which used the '''Enforce''' engine).
An early version of the {{ofp}} engine can be downloaded  {{Link|http://tom4897.info/?attachment_id{{=}}2258|here}}.
